cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a neighbourhood café with a counter and window seats — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — sitting on the ground; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — standing; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — standing; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — holds her keepsake at chest height; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — standing; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — sitting on the ground; her crew cabin aboard a starship — lying on her front; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — examines a small object on the table through a magnifying glass; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake up beside her face; an outdoor court for tennis or basketball — standing
